title: Digital Third Second and Carver Brickyard Air Permit 74262-4 — Phase 65 Climate review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Climate reporting pack. Virginia DEQ's registry links two Prince William County entities to minor new-source-review permit 74262-4 issued June 24, 2026.
key_findings: The registry names both permitted entities and a common facility-level record.
The June 2026 issue date makes it a current follow-up target.
The permit establishes conditions rather than built, tested, compliant, or operating equipment.
why_it_matters: Which records move global or program-level climate evidence toward a named exposure, responsible authority, intervention, and measured local result? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It adds another current named permit trail for later construction and compliance evidence.
ftfn_relevance: Deepens the Prince William implementation shelf.
Supports comparison with the 2026 state guidance.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The permit does not prove installation, testing, or continuing compliance.
It does not establish data-center occupancy, electricity service, or measured outcomes.
